question.text: The balancing length for a cell is <math><mn>560</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math> in a potentiometer experiment. When an external resistance of <math><mn>10</mn><mi></mi><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi></math>  is connected in parallel to the cell, the balancing length changes by <math><mn>60</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math> . If the internal resistance of the cell is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mtext>n</mtext><mn>10</mn></mfrac><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi></math> , where n is an integer then value of n is ________

solution.text:
Let the emf of cell is ε internal resistance is 'r' and potential gradient is x .
Only cell connected:
E=560x  -----1
After connecting the resistor
E×1010+r=500x   ------2
From 1 and 2
560x×1010+r=500x
56=50+5r
r=65=1.2Ω
so,n=12
